title: Vice Chair
overview: Leading club operations and strategy initiatives to enhance community engagement and streamline event execution.

details.description: Organized meetings to plan events, coordinate strategies, and ensure smooth operations through effective communication with all teams.
details.impact: Improved club reach and participation through strategic initiatives and collaborative efforts, fostering a stronger robotics community within the college.

title: Vice Chair
overview: Assisting the chair in managing and executing events while providing oversight and guidance to team members.

details.description: Supported the chair in organizing, coordinating, and executing technical events and workshops, ensuring smooth operations across all teams.
details.impact: Enhanced event quality and team performance by maintaining effective supervision and structured workflows for multiple initiatives.

title: Technical Head
overview: Provided technical leadership for system design, testing, and team mentoring in programming and automation.

details.description: Guided team members in technical aspects of robotics projects, organized tech workshops, and supervised system testing and development.
details.impact: Successfully executed workshops and achieved strong performance in RoboVeda competitions, demonstrating technical excellence and mentoring impact.

title: Core Team Member
overview: Contributed to hands-on robotics projects and educational workshops for students.

details.description: Conducted workshops providing guidance on microcontrollers, sensors, and actuators. Delivered talks on robotics and drone technologies at events and seminars.
details.impact: Enhanced student learning and engagement in robotics, fostering practical skills and knowledge in electronics and automation.
